candidate_sentence_map.S1: During the first quarter of 2026, VILVI Group reported consolidated revenue of 86.97 million euros, a 22.4 percent increase compared to the prior year.

candidate_sentence_map.S3: Revenue from fresh milk products rose 73.4 percent, dry milk products increased 126.9 percent, and the newly consolidated canned milk segment contributed 11.92 million euros.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Geographic sales showed accelerated momentum, with Lithuania surging 72.9 percent and other countries advancing 46.6 percent, while European Union sales remained flat.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: The group procured 155,954 tons of basic indicator milk, up 54.2 percent, reflecting heightened processing capacity utilization.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Operational profitability contracted significantly despite the revenue expansion.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: EBITDA declined 50.2 percent to 3.00 million euros, reducing the margin to 3.5 percent from 8.5 percent.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Gross profit fell to 5.42 million euros from 7.46 million euros, while distribution and administrative expenses more than doubled as the company scaled operations and integrated new assets.

candidate_sentence_map.S10: This divergence between declining EBITDA and rising net earnings is explicitly attributed to a preliminary negative goodwill gain of 5.5 million euros stemming from the January acquisition of Marijampolės pieno konservai UAB.

candidate_sentence_map.S12: Capital investment and financing activities materially altered the financial position.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Net financial debt surged 89.7 percent to 83.43 million euros, primarily funded through increased borrowings that accompanied 4.52 million euros in capital expenditures.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: These investments coincide with the official commencement of commercial cheese production at the new Baltic Dairy Board SIA facility in Bauska, Latvia.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: The new factory targets an annual capacity of 18,000 tons for export to over forty countries and recently secured third place in the 2025 Latvian Construction Awards.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Consequently, total assets expanded to 220.31 million euros, while cash reserves contracted to 951 thousand euros amid active infrastructure deployment and working capital demands.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: The reporting period fundamentally reflects a strategic shift toward scaled manufacturing and portfolio consolidation, where volume-driven revenue growth and acquisition accounting benefits currently support headline profitability even as near-term operational margins and leverage face headwinds from expansion costs.
